task_description:
Extract every place (location) mentioned in a Ukrainian or Russian Telegram post from Kyiv local news channels.
Answer with a JSON list of strings, each copied exactly as it appears in the post (same inflection, capitalization and spelling), without the preceding preposition and without trailing punctuation. List each distinct string once. Answer [] if there are no places.
Label: countries, regions, oblasts, cities, towns, villages, city districts and neighbourhoods, streets/avenues/squares with their type word and house number when present ("вулиці Хрещатик", "вул. Січових Стрільців, 12"), metro stations, rivers and seas, and district phrases ("Оболонському районі"). Coordinated names sharing one plural head are listed bare ("Луганських та Донецьких областей" -> "Луганських", "Донецьких").
Do not label: adjectives and demonyms ("київський", "киян"), organization or media names even if they contain a place ("Київенерго", "Національна поліція України"), place names inside channel signatures or footers ("Київ — пряма трансляція"), landmarks such as malls, parks, monuments and hospitals, and front directions ("Лиманському напрямку").
llm_as_a_judge_instructions: The answer must be a JSON list of strings. It is correct when it contains exactly the places present in the post according to the task description: every string must occur verbatim in the post, no place may be missing, and no organization name, footer, landmark or adjective may be included. The order of strings does not matter.
synthetic_data_generation_instructions: Write new, realistic Telegram posts in the style of Kyiv local news channels, like the examples. Use line breaks and occasional channel-style footers as in the examples; about half of the posts use no emoji at all, the rest one to three. Write fluent, grammatical Ukrainian or Russian. Vary the places: many different Kyiv districts, neighbourhoods, streets with house numbers or number ranges, metro stations, villages and towns of Kyiv oblast and other regions of Ukraine, and foreign countries; avoid reusing the same few places. Do not copy or paraphrase the example posts and do not reuse their structure; invent new events, people, numbers and wording, and start posts in different ways. Label each new post exactly following the task description; an address like "вулиці Кірова, 2-14" keeps its numbers.
